description: This PHP file is a Smarty plugin that provides an output filter function to trim unnecessary whitespace from HTML markup, including handling HTML comments, script, textarea, and pre tags, and optimizing spacing between tags and attributes.
external_files: php (standard library functions like preg_replace, preg_match_all, substr_replace, strlen)

methods.name: smarty_outputfilter_trimwhitespace
methods.description: Main function to process an HTML source string by removing unnecessary whitespace, comments, and handling special tags
